headline: Nigerian Government Warns Oil Companies to Develop Assets or Relinquish Licences
summary: The Nigerian federal government declared an end to holding petroleum assets without development, insisting operators must invest or relinquish licences under the Petroleum Industry Act.
why: Enforcing drill-or-drop provisions aims to unlock stalled hydrocarbon production and increase capital expenditure in Nigeria's key upstream oil and gas sector.

impacts.name: Upstream Oil and Gas
impacts.why: Stricter regulatory enforcement may force inactive asset sales or boost development spending by incumbent operators.
